name: Website Audit
seoTitle: Free Website Audit — AI-Powered Growth Analysis
metaDescription: Run a free, comprehensive website audit in under 30 seconds. Get a real, data-backed report covering SEO, speed, accessibility, trust and conversion.
intro: A website audit checks every technical, SEO and conversion factor that determines whether your site turns visitors into enquiries. Our free AI-powered audit scans your homepage in real time and reports exactly what's holding you back — no generic advice, no waiting for an agency.
whatWeCheck: SEO fundamentals: titles, meta descriptions, headings, structured data
Performance: Core Web Vitals, image sizes, render-blocking resources
Accessibility: alt text, contrast, form labels, keyboard navigation
Trust signals: SSL, testimonials, contact details, business hours
Mobile experience: viewport, responsive layout, touch targets
Conversion: calls-to-action, contact forms, trust badges
Local SEO: Google Business Profile, location pages, reviews

faq.question: How long does a website audit take?
faq.answer: Our AI audit completes in under 30 seconds — enter your URL and get a full, categorised report instantly, no sign-up required to see your score.

faq.question: Is the website audit really free?
faq.answer: Yes. Running the audit and viewing your dashboard is completely free. We only ask for your details if you want to download the full branded PDF report.

faq.question: What does the audit actually check?
faq.answer: We fetch your live homepage and run real checks across SEO, performance (via Google PageSpeed Insights), accessibility, trust, mobile-friendliness, conversion optimisation and local SEO — every recommendation is based on what's actually detected on your site.
